ed25519Precompile.note: Called through a raw staticcall, never a typed interface: solc inserts an extcodesize check before any high-level call that ABI-decodes returndata, and a precompile has no code, so a typed call would revert on-chain. The forge fork test (P-03) cannot exercise this — forge's local EVM does not implement the precompile and returns 0 bytes — so the live cast probe is the liveness proof, and P-03 fails in-repo for that reason alone.
